Under the gates, no production change lands without a scenario first.
say: I counted, today, in the repository. 201 feature files. 1,273 scenarios, each one a behavior written down before its code, like the library's four rows. 1,117 commits since the 19th of April. 365 Kotlin production files, across the HEART library, the client, the domains, the MCP server and the Spring server. Under the gates, no production change lands without a scenario first. So what did all of that build?
